journal_lines: Phantom diving from above. Watched for the shadow.
Screech overhead. Looked up in time.
They come in pairs at this depth.
Two stars where its eyes ought to be. Stars do not blink.
It made a sound like canvas tearing. Then it was canvas, falling.
Caught the wing on the upstroke. Lighter than it looked. Easier than it sounded.
Found their feathers in the grass after. Soft as soot.
Older than sleep, and angry about it.
Cast a shadow on the path the size of a small house.
Came at me out of a sky I had stopped watching.
Membrane and bone. Did not bleed. Did fall.
